device.unreachable: The printer is not answering on the network. Check that it is powered on and that its IP address is still correct.

pair.title: Find your printer
pair.intro: Enter the printer's IP address. It must be on the same network as Homey, and SNMP must be enabled — it is on by default on almost every network printer.
pair.error_unreachable: No SNMP answer from that address. Check the IP, and that SNMP is enabled on the printer.
pair.searching: Looking for printers on your network…
pair.none_found: No printer answered on this network. If yours is on a different subnet, or uses a community other than "public", add it by address below.
pair.repair_intro: Enter the printer's current IP address. Use this when the printer moved to a new address and stopped answering.
